candidate.name: NONEXPANDING_DP_POLARITY_PRODUCT_KERNEL
candidate.rule: For a variable v with p positive and q negative occurrences, eliminate v by Davis-Putnam whenever p*q <= p+q. Use a fixed deterministic tie-break among eligible variables.
candidate.rank: number of remaining variables during the reduction phase

global_polynomial_phase_bound.clause_count: Eliminating v removes p+q pivot clauses and adds at most p*q non-tautological resolvents. Under p*q<=p+q, the clause count never increases.
global_polynomial_phase_bound.literal_state: With at most m_0 clauses and at most n_0 remaining variables, every simple clause has length at most n_0, so the total literal encoding stays O(m_0*n_0), polynomial in the original input size.
global_polynomial_phase_bound.steps: At most n_0 eliminations because each legal step removes one variable.
global_polynomial_phase_bound.charged_work: Each step constructs at most p*q<=p+q<=m_0 resolvents, each of polynomial length; therefore the whole legal reduction phase is polynomially bounded.

strict_extension_of_R44AS.balanced_degree_4: p=q=2 gives p*q=4=p+q, so R44AT safely eliminates variables that R44AS would leave in the degree-4 core.
strict_extension_of_R44AS.new_fixed_point_condition: Every remaining variable satisfies p*q>p+q, equivalently (p-1)(q-1)>1.

published_hard_fixed_point.source: Andreas Darmann and Janosch Döcker, On simplified NP-complete variants of Monotone 3-Sat, Discrete Applied Mathematics 292 (2021), 45-58, DOI 10.1016/j.dam.2020.12.010.
published_hard_fixed_point.statement_used: Monotone 3-Sat-(3,2) is NP-complete; every variable appears exactly three times unnegated and exactly two times negated.
published_hard_fixed_point.arithmetic: For every variable in this class, p=3 and q=2, hence p*q=6>5=p+q.
published_hard_fixed_point.effect: The R44AT rule has no legal first move on this entire NP-complete exact-3-literal class, so the polynomial nonexpanding DP kernel is not universal progress.
published_hard_fixed_point.scope: This is a fixed-route barrier. NP-completeness does not imply P!=NP.

next_admissible_math.question: Can one define an exact polynomial transition for residual variables with p*q>p+q, especially the minimal hard (3,2)/(2,3) polarity-product core, that strictly lowers a proved global rank without causing superpolynomial state growth or branching?
